description:
An invite to join D-Qbies.

Hi, I'm James Kekeli, a software developer specializing in backend applications and services. I also build mobile apps, websites, and desktop apps. My preferred stack includes JavaScript, Python, Go, NestJS, Next.js, Express, FastAPI, and Django.

I'd love for you to join my team, D-Qbies, for the NASA Space Apps Challenge Hackathon. Let's take on the challenge together!
